master_immutability: All accepted master rows are preserved byte for byte. clinical_condition receives new assertions; no demographic overwrite or additional patient row is fabricated.
death_authority: Encounter DEATH is the observed clinical death authority, regardless of registration.deceased_at being unknown. Only terminal December 2025 inpatient episodes have death outcomes. No later care may occur; delayed registration reconciliation remains explicit for source integration. Null registration death is not an assertion of survival.
capture_scope: Selected non-exhaustive adult care evidence: two contextual analytes with repeated inpatient collection, two changing observation series, a pathway procedure and selected oral treatment courses. No claim of complete EHR, ICU pharmacotherapy, full medication reconciliation or nationally representative prevalence.
known_limitations: Clinical plausibility reviewed by user-designated Codex, not a licensed clinician endorsement.
Doses are narrow label-bounded synthetic order assumptions; full patient-specific contraindication/interaction decision support is outside scope.
Full resource-constrained timing, stock issues, charge reconciliation and downstream source replay remain later phase gates.
No source row generated in this phase represents real care or a verified professional credential.
